company.name: WINPAC Trading Company
company.tagline: Have a surface problem? Let's solve it.
company.intro: Abrasives, machines, stone care chemicals and natural stone aggregates for granite and marble factories, flooring contractors and restorers across Sri Lanka.
company.motto: We solve a problem, not just sell a product.
company.about: WINPAC Trading Company was started by K. Balasubramaniam in 1988 as a supplier of terrazzo materials. Today we are the official distributor for manufacturers around the world, supplying solutions for terrazzo, cement, concrete, natural stone and engineered surfaces. As the largest market share holder in our industry, we take equal pride and responsibility in every product we sell.
company.vision: To continuously be the most trusted provider of solutions to problems and requirements of any scale, for any and all surfaces in Sri Lanka.
company.mission: To understand the requirements of our customers and provide the right solution, through our partners or by manufacturing it ourselves.
company.hours: Monday to Saturday, 8.30 am to 5.30 pm
company.chemText: Where the right product doesn't exist off the shelf, we develop one for your surface. Since 2018 we have provided customised chemical solutions that save contractors time and money.

products.name: Stornello Sander
products.summary: Compact Italian sanding and polishing machine for edges, steps and small areas.
products.description: The Stornello from Künzle & Tasin is a compact, easy-to-handle machine for sanding and polishing where large floor machines can't work: along edges, on steps and landings, and in small rooms. Ask us which version suits stone or wood.

products.name: Abtex Floor Polishing & Buffing Pads
products.summary: Non-woven floor pads in colour-coded grades for scrubbing, buffing and polishing.
products.description: Abtex non-woven pads for single-disc machines and scrubbers. The colours mark the job, from aggressive cleaning and stripping to gentle buffing and polishing. Use them for daily maintenance, crystallising and bringing up the shine on stone and terrazzo floors.

products.name: Segmented Diamond Grinding Disc
products.summary: Metal-bond segmented disc for single-head floor and edge grinders.
products.description: A steel disc with a full ring of metal-bond diamond segments, for single-head floor and edge grinders. It is used for fast concrete grinding, levelling and coating removal.

features: Bonds for soft, medium and hard concrete
products.name: Trapezoid Diamond Grinding Shoes
products.summary: Metal-bond diamond segments on quick-change trapezoid plates for planetary floor grinders.
products.description: Twin metal-bond diamond segments on a trapezoid plate that clips onto the heads of planetary floor grinders. Used to grind and level concrete, remove coatings and adhesives, and open up terrazzo before resin polishing. Choose the bond to suit the hardness of the concrete.

products.name: GX250 Edge & Compact Floor Grinder
products.summary: Portable 250 mm single-phase grinder for edges, corners and tight spaces.
products.description: A compact single-head grinder for the places larger machines can't reach: wall edges, around columns, and through narrow doorways. It runs on single-phase power, with a soft start that helps avoid tripped breakers on weak site supplies. It is used for concrete profiling, coating and epoxy removal and surface preparation. It breaks down quickly for transport in a car.

features: Dry dust collection with floor grinders
Removes fine particles for a scratch-free polish
products.name: Wet & Dry Vacuum 60 L, 2 Motor
products.summary: Two-motor wet and dry vacuum for slurry pickup between polishing steps and dust-free grinding.
products.description: Use it to vacuum the floor clean after each polishing step, so the fine particles left behind can't scratch the surface in the next step. It also collects dry dust when connected to a floor grinder. The 60-litre, two-motor size suits most restoration and polishing jobs.

features: Dry dust collection with floor grinders
Removes fine particles for a scratch-free polish
Three motors for strong suction on large jobs
products.name: Wet & Dry Vacuum 80 L, 3 Motor
products.summary: Large three-motor vacuum that picks up slurry, water and dust between polishing steps.
products.description: Vacuuming the floor clean after every polishing step removes the fine particles left behind, so they can't scratch the surface in the next step. That is the key to a scratch-free polish. The 80-litre, three-motor model suits large floors and heavy slurry. It also works dry: connect it to a floor grinder to collect dust and grind dust-free.

features: Supplied with hard and soft brushes and a pad driver

specs.label: Includes
specs.value: Hard brush, soft brush, pad driver, grinding and polishing plate

products.name: Single Disc Diamond Polisher 2 HP
products.summary: Single-disc machine for diamond polishing, buffing and scrubbing marble floors.
products.description: A versatile single-disc floor machine for diamond polishing, buffing and scrubbing marble floors. It comes with hard and soft brushes and a pad driver, so one machine covers polishing and daily cleaning.

specs.label: Range
specs.value: Black stripper, Blue cleaning, Red buffer, White polishing

products.name: Floor Cleaning & Polishing Pads
products.summary: Colour-coded floor machine pads for stripping, scrubbing, buffing and polishing.
products.description: A full set of non-woven pads for single-disc machines and scrubbers, colour-coded by job. Black pads strip old finishes. Blue pads handle heavy scrubbing. Red pads cover daily cleaning, spray buffing and crystallising. White pads give the final polish and buff.

specs.label: Coats
specs.value: 2, each burnished with a 3000-grit or finer pad

specs.label: Traffic
specs.value: Foot traffic when tack-free, equipment after 24 hours

products.name: Stain Protector Concentrate
products.summary: Water-based guard for polished concrete and terrazzo that resists stains and burnishes to a high gloss.
products.description:
A breathable sealer that partly penetrates and partly forms a film. It gives polished concrete and cement terrazzo a water-resistant barrier against stains and etching, leaving time to clean up spills. It deepens the floor's colour, protects against UV and makes cleaning easier.

Dilute 1:1 with water and test a small area first. Mist it on and spread it evenly with a microfibre mop. When tack-free, burnish with a 3000-grit or finer pad. Apply a second coat the same way, plus a third in heavy-spill areas.

features: Reduces efflorescence and diamond tool wear

specs.label: Coverage
specs.value: 20 to 60 sq ft per litre, depending on porosity

products.name: Densi-Hard Lithium Silicate
products.summary: Deep-penetrating lithium densifier for harder, dust-free, more reflective concrete and terrazzo.
products.description: A lithium silicate densifier for concrete and terrazzo. Its small molecules penetrate deep, hardening the floor so it grinds and polishes well and stays reflective for longer. It makes concrete dustproof, improves abrasion resistance, reduces efflorescence, and cuts wear on diamond tools, lowering long-term maintenance costs.

features: Reduces efflorescence and diamond tool wear

specs.label: Coverage
specs.value: 20 to 60 sq ft per litre, depending on porosity

products.name: Densi-Hard Sodium Silicate
products.summary: Economical liquid densifier that hardens and dustproofs concrete and terrazzo floors.
products.description:
A sodium silicate densifier for concrete and terrazzo. It reacts in the surface layer to give a hard floor that grinds and polishes well. Its larger molecules fill pores efficiently, so less product is needed. It reduces dusting and efflorescence, improves abrasion resistance, and cuts wear on diamond tools.

Suited to interior and exterior concrete, polished concrete, warehouses, factories, food storage areas, and commercial and residential floors. Cover nearby metal, brick, wood, glass and painted surfaces before spraying.

features: Fits Fickert heads on line polishers
products.name: R1 Diamond Fickert Brushes
products.summary: Diamond-filament Fickert brushes for leathered and antique finishes on granite.
products.description: Abrasive filament brushes on a Fickert body for automatic line polishers. They are used to give granite a textured leathered or antique finish instead of a high polish. Supplied in several colour-coded grades, used from coarse to fine.

features: For marble, granite and stone floors
products.name: 8" Buff Plate
products.summary: 200 mm buffing plate for the final shine on stone floors.
products.description: A buffing plate used as the last step after diamond polishing, to bring marble, granite and other stone floors to a deep, even shine.

products.name: 8" Resin Bond Diamond Plate
products.summary: 200 mm resin-bond diamond plate for polishing stone floors.
products.description: A resin-bonded diamond plate for floor polishing machines. Used in grit sequence to polish granite and other stone floors after grinding.

products.name: Resin Fickert 140
products.summary: Resin-bond diamond Fickert for smoothing and polishing granite on line polishers.
products.description: Diamond in a resin bond on a standard 140 mm Fickert. Used after the metal-bond stage to take out scratches and build gloss on granite slabs and tiles. Work through the grit sequence on automatic line polishers.

products.name: Metal Fickert 140
products.summary: Metal-bond diamond Fickert for fast first-stage grinding on granite line polishers.
products.description: Diamond segments in a metal bond, mounted on a standard 140 mm Fickert. Used for the first grinding passes on granite slabs and tiles on automatic line polishers. It opens up the surface quickly after sawing or calibrating, so the resin Fickerts that follow have less work to do.

features: Wax-free: the shine comes from reacting with the surface
Seals pores, so less dust builds up
For final polishing, renovation or regular maintenance

specs.label: Surfaces
specs.value: Granite, vitrified and porcelain tiles, quartz, green marble, sandstone

products.name: Gloex Granite Polishing Cream
products.summary: Wax-free cream polish that gives granite, vitrified and porcelain floors a brilliant shine.
products.description: Gloex Cream is a water-based cream polish with no wax. It reacts with the surface to produce the shine, and it seals the pores so dust builds up less. It can be used at the end of granite polishing, to revive old worn floors, or for routine maintenance.

features: High gloss on marble and limestone
Restores shine in worn traffic lanes

specs.label: Dose
specs.value: Up to 2 to 3 sprays per m²

products.name: SP-1 Liquid Crystalliser
products.summary: Spray crystalliser for the regular maintenance of marble and limestone floors.
products.description:
SP-1 gives marble and other calcareous stone a high gloss. Crystallising makes the floor harder-wearing and less sensitive to acids. It is also used to bring worn traffic lanes on previously crystallised floors back to a shine.

Spray sparingly and work it in with a single-disc machine and a steel wool or white pad until dry. Repeat once for more shine. Remove all pad residue afterwards with a damp mop or Surie Polex Floor Cleaner Neutral. For a deeper gloss, finish with a white pad on a high-speed burnisher.

features: Applied with a standard single-disc machine

specs.label: Pads
specs.value: Red pad to apply, white pad to finish

specs.label: After use
specs.value: Wash with Floor Cleaner Neutral and vacuum dry

products.name: Z-Xtra Marble Crystallising Powder
products.summary: Crystallising powder that brings marble floors to a high-gloss finish.
products.description:
Mix Z-Xtra with water into a paste and work it into the wetted floor with a single-disc machine and red pad. Go across the floor one way, then at right angles. The gloss appears as the paste dries. Mist with water if it dries too quickly, then buff with a white pad for extra shine. Afterwards, wash the floor with Surie Polex Floor Cleaner Neutral and vacuum it dry.

Mix the paste just before use, protect nearby furniture and other floor types from splashes, wear gloves and boots, and store the powder dry.

features: Repels water and dirt, keeps the natural look
Breathable and UV resistant, for indoor and outdoor use
Also seals the underside of stone before laying

specs.label: Surfaces
specs.value: Sandstone, concrete, travertine, marble, granite, limestone

products.name: Sandstone Sealer WZ
products.summary: Water-based deep-penetrating sealer that repels water and dirt on absorbent stone and concrete.
products.description:
A premium water-based sealer that soaks deep into absorbent surfaces such as sandstone, concrete, travertine, marble, granite and limestone, and repels water and dirt. It keeps the stone's natural look, lets moisture vapour escape and is UV resistant, for indoor and outdoor use.

It can also seal the underside of stone. Apply it at least 24 hours before laying to stop moisture rising through the stone. Apply 2 to 3 coats with a brush, roller, sponge or sprayer, and wipe off any extra.

features: Protects against water- and oil-based stains

specs.label: Curing
specs.value: Repels water within minutes, fully cured in 12 to 24 hours

specs.label: Application
specs.value: Brush, roller, sprayer or lint-free cloth

products.name: STAINEX Floor Sealer
products.summary: Impregnating sealer that protects natural stone against water- and oil-based stains.
products.description:
STAINEX soaks into natural stone and protects it against both water- and oil-based stains, while repelling water and dirt. The stone can still breathe, and the sealer is UV resistant.

Apply it to a clean, dry surface. Test a small patch first, because some stones darken slightly. Apply 2 to 3 even coats with a brush, roller, sprayer or lint-free cloth, and wipe off any surplus. Keep it away from direct sun and moisture while it cures. In food areas, ventilate for 2 to 3 days.

features: Deepens colour and brings out veining
Protects against water, dirt and stains
UV and weather resistant, for indoor and outdoor use

specs.label: Stones
specs.value: Granite, slate, limestone, travertine and other natural stone

products.name: TRUKOLOR Colour Enhancer
products.summary: Penetrating sealer that deepens natural stone colour and protects against water, dirt and stains.
products.description: TRUKOLOR soaks into natural stone to deepen its colour and bring out its veining and texture. It suits granite, slate, limestone, travertine and other natural stone. It protects against water, dirt and stains, and it resists UV and weather, so it can be used indoors and outdoors: patios, walkways, countertops, pool decks and fireplaces. The stone can still breathe, which helps prevent efflorescence and damage from trapped moisture.

features: Removes coatings, adhesives, paint and line markings
Prepares concrete for epoxy and PU coatings
products.name: Floor Grinder Scarifier SP250
products.summary: Heavy-duty scarifier that strips coatings and prepares concrete for epoxy and PU floors.
products.description: The SP250 uses a fast-spinning drum of cutters to mill the floor surface. It removes old coatings, adhesives, paint, line markings and surface contamination, and prepares concrete before epoxy, polyurethane and other floor coatings are laid. The drum can be changed to suit different jobs and surfaces.

features: Planetary drive for an even finish
products.name: Floor Grinding Machine HSP-400
products.summary: 400 mm planetary grinder for grinding and polishing smaller marble, granite and concrete areas.
products.description: The HSP-400 has a planetary drive in an aluminium-alloy gearbox and variable speed through a frequency drive. It suits grinding and polishing smaller areas of marble, granite and concrete. The handle folds and the machine separates for easy transport. A vacuum connection allows dust-free work.

features: Supplied with brushes, pad driver and extra weights
products.name: Single Disc Diamond Polisher 2.5 HP
products.summary: 430 mm single-disc machine for diamond polishing, buffing and scrubbing marble floors.
products.description: A heavy single-disc machine built for diamond polishing, buffing and scrubbing marble floors. It comes with brushes, a pad driver and extra weights for more pressure when grinding.

features: Easy to use, no specialist needed
Works on machines you already have
products.name: Floor Polishing Pads (5-Step)
products.summary: Five-step diamond pads that polish and maintain floors using only water.
products.description: The DCM floor pads keep floors at a high gloss all year without polishing chemicals. Work through the five steps in order, using water only. They fit standard floor machines, so no special equipment or specialist contractor is needed, and they cut the time spent on floor maintenance.

features: For stone, terrazzo, slate, terracotta, wood, cork and plastic floors

specs.label: Coats
specs.value: 2, the second at right angles to the first

specs.label: Preparation
specs.value: Strip, rinse and dry the floor first

products.name: AB-10-B Metallising Varnish (Gloss)
products.summary: Self-shining emulsion that dries to a hard, glossy protective layer.
products.description:
AB-10-B is a self-shining finish for natural stone, terrazzo, slate, terracotta, wood, cork and plastic floors. No buffing is needed: it dries to a hard, shiny coat that protects the surface.

Apply it to a clean floor that has been stripped and fully dried. Spread it neat in straight, even lines with a sponge or wax applicator, not in circles. Let it dry, then apply a second coat at right angles to the first.

features: Seals and crystallises in one step
For marble, terrazzo, granite, porcelain, quartz and engineered stone
Used neat, straight from the container

specs.label: Application
specs.value: Floor machine with steel wool pad

specs.label: Coverage
specs.value: About 40 ml per 2 m² per pass

products.name: CR-15 Multi-Purpose Crystalliser
products.summary: Liquid sealer-crystalliser that gives marble and terrazzo floors a hard, glossy finish.
products.description:
CR-15 seals and crystallises marble and terrazzo floors in one step. It also brings up the shine on natural granite and is suited to the upkeep of porcelain tile, quartz and engineered stone.

Shake well and use it neat, never diluted or mixed. Spray a little onto a small area, spread it with a polishing machine fitted with a steel wool pad, and work it until completely dry. Move on area by area until the whole floor is done.
